Driving indications: - Vehicle displays messages when the ignition is switched on.
- Warning and indicator lights provide information about vehicle systems.
- Power meter shows energy consumption and recuperation in real time.
- Drive readiness is shown with a READY indicator in the display.
Connecting and disconnecting the drive s: - The drive system is activated when pressing the brake and selecting a gear.
- READY appears in the display once the system is active.
- Drive system is disconnected automatically when the vehicle is parked and switched off.
- To deactivate, press the START button without the brake pedal.
Gear selection: - The gear selector lever is located on the steering column.
- Available positions: D (Drive), R (Reverse), N (Neutral), P (Park).
- To change from P or N to D or R, press the brake.
- Always engage P when parking the vehicle.
- Selector includes a manual mode for recuperation control.
Energy recuperation with the steering wh: - Steering wheel paddles adjust the level of energy recuperation.
- Recuperation slows the vehicle and charges the battery.
- Three levels available: low, medium, and high.
- Selection affects driving feel and energy efficiency.
Steering: - Steering is electric and adjusts with vehicle speed.
- At low speeds, it provides light assistance for easy maneuvering.
- At high speeds, it firms up for improved control.
- Avoid holding the steering at full lock for long periods.
Drive Profiles: - Several driving profiles are available: Range, Comfort, Performance, etc.
- Profiles modify steering, drive system, suspension, and climate settings.
- Off-road profile optimizes traction on loose surfaces.
- Profile selection can be made via infotainment.
- User-defined profile may be available for custom settings.
Braking system: - Vehicle uses an electronic brake system with regenerative function.
- Brake energy recovery supplements conventional braking.
- Brake pedal feel may differ slightly from traditional systems.
- System is monitored for safety and reliability.
Brake assist systems: - Includes features like ABS, ESC, and emergency brake assist.
- Prevents wheel lock-up and helps maintain steering during hard braking.
- ESC corrects vehicle path in skidding situations.
- Hill hold assist prevents rollback when starting on inclines.
